modules.name: drop-app
build-commands: desktop_file="$(find extracted/usr/share/applications -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.desktop' -print -quit)" && test -n "$desktop_file" && install -Dm644 "$desktop_file" /app/share/applications/org.droposs.client.desktop && sed -i -e 's|^Exec=.*|Exec=drop-app|' -e 's|^TryExec=.*|TryExec=drop-app|' /app/share/applications/org.droposs.client.desktop
if [ -d extracted/usr/share/icons ]; then cp -a extracted/usr/share/icons/. /app/share/icons/; fi
if [ -d extracted/usr/share/pixmaps ]; then cp -a extracted/usr/share/pixmaps/. /app/share/pixmaps/; fi
